<!-- pr-preamble:end -->

<!-- auto-status-summary:start -->
## Automated Status Summary
#### Scope
In tools/discover_model_catalog.py lines 61-72, the parse_catalog function handles provider == "github-models" by filtering items with item.get("publisher") == "OpenAI". The GitHub Models catalog publishes models from multiple organizations (including Meta, Mistral AI, Microsoft, and Cohere). Filtering exclusively on publisher == "OpenAI" silently drops all non-OpenAI models from catalog discovery, blinding the repository catalog drift detection to newly available multi-provider models on GitHub Models.

<!-- Updated WORKFLOW_OUTPUTS.md context:start -->
## Context for Agent

### Related Issues/PRs
- [#558](https://github.com/stranske/Workflows/issues/558)
<!-- Updated WORKFLOW_OUTPUTS.md context:end -->

#### Tasks
- [x] Update parse_catalog in tools/discover_model_catalog.py to accept models from all publishers on GitHub Models
- [x] Add unit tests in tests/tools/test_discover_model_catalog.py covering multi-publisher GitHub Models catalog payloads

#### Acceptance criteria
- [x] `python tools/discover_model_catalog.py` parses multi-publisher catalog entries without error.
- [x] `pytest tests/tools/test_discover_model_catalog.py` passes all test cases.
- [x] Deliberate-break demonstration: restoring the strict OpenAI publisher check causes `pytest tests/tools/test_discover_model_catalog.py` to fail on multi-publisher fixtures, and reverting restores pass.

<!-- auto-status-summary:end -->

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

- **New Features**
  - Expanded model catalog discovery to include eligible models from all publishers when valid IDs and capabilities are present.
  - Added catalog drift reporting for newly discovered candidates without automatically adding them to the registry.

- **Bug Fixes**
  - Improved resilience when catalog entries contain invalid or unsupported timestamp values.
  - Preserved valid model creation timestamps during catalog processing.

- **Tests**
  - Added coverage for publisher support, required metadata, timestamp handling, drift reporting, and consistent JSON output.
<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Implementation and validation evidence

Multi-publisher catalog parsing and its named fixture CLI tests are implemented. Numeric timestamp recovery now catches OSError, OverflowError and ValueError, preserving models with unknown dates and continuing to later entries.

`python3 -m pytest tests/tools/test_discover_model_catalog.py -q`: **19 passed**. Removing the numeric exception guard yields **8 failed, 11 passed**, then restoration returns **19 passed**. Black, Ruff, mypy and diff checks pass. The prior publisher-predicate mutation yielded 6 failures and restoration passed. The live GitHub Models endpoint returned HTTP 410 during initial implementation; this is not a live API parsing success. The fixture CLI proves multi-publisher parsing/reporting and registry immutability; endpoint replacement remains outside issue #3431.

Post-push review and active-thread disposition remain required before exact-head merge/compare.
